# The Friend at Midnight (Luke 11:5-8)

## Bible Story Retelling

Jesus told this gentle story: a man had a friend who came to him at midnight and said, “Friend, lend me three loaves; for a friend of mine is come to me and I have nothing to set before him.” The man inside answered, “Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.” But because the friend kept asking, the man rose and gave him as many as he needed. Jesus said, “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.” God loves to hear us when we pray.

## Coloring Page Prompt

Create one simple black-and-white line-art coloring page for ages 3–8. Clean bold outlines, large open spaces. Peaceful scene: a man standing at a closed door at night holding a lantern, gently knocking while his friend inside the house smiles and hands out loaves of bread through the window. Soft moonlight. Focus on the heart moment of a friend helping at midnight. Calm, kind, hopeful, reverent.

## Read-Along Flow

Child colors the page. Tap “I’m finished coloring” → gentle transition to the read-aloud retelling with natural pauses. Ends with peaceful loop or “Next Story in the Gentle Journey.”
